sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Settings template
sections.what: Lists every setting the backend reads, with sample values for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, SharePoint, storage, the app, caching, and the agent.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows new users which settings they must fill in.
sections.watch_out: Some sample values differ from the defaults in the config file, such as temperature 0.7 here and 0.3 there, and a copied file overrides those defaults.

summary: A template that lists every setting the backend reads, with placeholder values, to be copied into a real settings file.
purpose: Tells a developer which settings to fill in before the backend can run.
why: Likely reason: documents the options without putting real secrets in the code.
how: Copy this file to a file named .env in the backend folder, replace the placeholders with real values, then start the backend.
inputs: Values typed in by the developer after copying.
outputs: Settings that the backend's config file reads when it starts.
risks: Real keys pasted into this template could be committed to the code repository. Some sample values differ from the defaults in the config file.
debug: If a setting seems ignored, check that its name matches exactly, that the file is named .env, and that it is in the folder where the program starts. The vector store type line has a trailing comment, which some readers may take as part of the value.
